title: Kannur University Notification 2026 - Apply for Project Assistant Posts
description: Kannur University has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies for 01 Project Assistant job. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their M.Sc, M.Pharm, M.E/ M.Tech can apply for the Kannur University Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply online.
